_comment: Operator-maintained providers and models for the LLM gateway (CP_MODEL_CATALOG_FILE).
Claude models are seeded automatically when CP_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set; list everything else here.
Prices are what customers pay, in USD per million tokens, before CP_PRICE_MULTIPLIER. They are left
null on purpose: look up each provider's current list price, add your margin and fill them in.
The control plane refuses to start while a price is missing, so a model is never free by accident.
API keys are read from the environment variables named in api_key_env, never from this file.
Entries are only added on first sight; change prices later in Admin -> Models & pricing.
